import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int M = 1000007;
    static final int N = 210;
    static char[][] s1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] s2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] id = new int[15][15];
    static int cnt;
    static int s, t, n, T;
    static int xz, yz;
    static int[][] dir = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};
    
    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && s1[x][y] >= '0' && s1[x][y] <= '9';
    }
    
    static ArrayList<Edge>[] graph;
    static int[] pre;
    static boolean[] vis;
    
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }
    
    static void add(int u, int v, int c) {
        graph[u].add(new Edge(v, graph[v].size(), c));
        graph[v].add(new Edge(u, graph[u].size()-1, 0));
    }
    
    static int[] qx1, qy1, qx2, qy2;
    static int h1, t1, h2, t2;
    static int[][] v1 = new int[15][15];
    static int[][] v2 = new int[15][15];
    
    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        if (s2[x][y] != 0) {
            add(id[x][y]+cnt, t, s2[x][y] - '0');
        }
        if (s1[x][y] == '0') return;
        add(s, id[x][y], s1[x][y] - '0');
        if (s2[x][y] != 0) {
            add(id[x][y], id[x][y]+cnt, 10);
        }
        
        int sx = x, sy = y;
        h1 = t1 = h2 = t2 = 0;
        qx1[t1] = x; qy1[t1] = y; t1++;
        qx2[t2] = xz; qy2[t2] = yz; t2++;
        
        int up1 = t1, up2 = t2;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(v1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(v2[i], -1);
        }
        v1[x][y] = 0;
        v2[xz][yz] = 0;
        
        while (h1 < t1) {
            while (h1 < up1) {
                int cx = qx1[h1], cy = qy1[h1]; h1++;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nx = cx + dir[d][0];
                    int ny = cy + dir[d][1];
                    if (inside(nx, ny) && v1[nx][ny] == -1) {
                        v1[nx][ny] = v1[cx][cy] + 1;
                        qx1[t1] = nx; qy1[t1] = ny; t1++;
                    }
                }
            }
            while (h2 < up2) {
                int cx = qx2[h2], cy = qy2[h2]; h2++;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int nx = cx + dir[d][0];
                    int ny = cy + dir[d][1];
                    if (inside(nx, ny) && v2[nx][ny] == -1) {
                        v2[nx][ny] = v2[cx][cy] + 1;
                        qx2[t2] = nx; qy2[t2] = ny; t2++;
                    }
                }
            }
            up1 = t1;
            up2 = t2;
        }
    }
    
    static boolean bfsFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        vis[s] = true;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); i++) {
                Edge e = graph[u].get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && !vis[e.to]) {
                    vis[e.to] = true;
                    pre[e.to] = e.rev;
                    if (e.to == t) return true;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static int maxFlow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsFlow()) {
            int mi = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int rev = pre[v];
                Edge e = graph[v].get(rev);
                mi = Math.min(mi, e.cap);
                v = e.to;
            }
            ans += mi;
            v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                int rev = pre[v];
                Edge e = graph[v].get(rev);
                e.cap -= mi;
                graph[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += mi;
                v = e.to;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                s1[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                s2[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(id[i], -1);
        }
        cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    xz = i; yz = j;
                } else if (inside(i, j)) {
                    id[i][j] = ++cnt;
                }
            }
        }
        s = 0;
        t = 2*cnt + 1;
        graph = new ArrayList[t+1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= t; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        pre = new int[t+1];
        vis = new boolean[t+1];
        
        qx1 = new int[500];
        qy1 = new int[500];
        qx2 = new int[500];
        qy2 = new int[500];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inside(i, j)) {
                    bfs(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
